test_title: PYST 03: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 05 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, P, Q, and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). R sits fourth to the left of B. D sits second to the right of B. A is an immediate neighbour of B and D. Q sits third to the left of A. P is an immediate neighbour of Q and R.

Who is sitting third to the right of R?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) R sits fourth to the left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c5ac1fbf8e9cdb1e0187ef8b034f4ad00c82d47e36fd0c7a5b9c27e2f222e94.png] 

2) D sits second to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83db437d582eb41d1cdea8c033f24a64bc390f52e75b27ad90b78701955d1333.png] 

3) A is an immediate neighbour of B and D.

4) Q sits third to the left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6a8de576fa989b8bfc91a8bdd949256a26b73b0c1cdda0c223f3b4f6cdeb9e4.png] 

5) P is an immediate neighbour of Q and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be5925647fd78a576a278d14c9c678afcc4ccf84ea8dd851f5669202f60d495a.png] 

Here, we can see that C is sitting third to the right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C"**.
